body:
In task:e86828d20aaab5a2, one leading space in the `write` paragraph of `solace-cli/src/reference.txt` used up six runs, three work and three review. Nothing measured the layout. The reviewers judged columns by eye from `read` output. The work runs couldn't see leading space at all: `read` adds a `NNN: ` prefix, `grep` collapses spaces, and `write`'s `old` matches a substring. This task makes a slip like that impossible to save.

## Change
- **Script** `solace-cli/tests/reference_layout.py <file>`: checks the "Commands in full" section of the reference. Exit 0 when the layout is clean. Otherwise, exit 1 with one line per fault: `line N: starts at column C; the descriptions start at column D` (or the width fault).
  - **Description column:** read it from the file (the column where descriptions start after the `  <syntax>` lines), not a hard-coded number.
  - A **command line** starts with two spaces. If its description is on the same line, it starts at the description column.
  - A **continuation line** (all spaces up to its text) starts exactly at the description column. The exception is an **indented example block**, like the `*** Begin Patch` example under `write`: lines deeper than the description column are allowed if the whole run of them shares one column.
  - **Group headings** (`Reading`, `Project: …`) and blank lines are left alone. So is the part before "Commands in full".
  - **Width:** no line is longer than the widest line the section has now. Measure that when writing the script and put the number in the script with a comment.
- **Validator:** the human adds `"solace-cli/src/reference.txt" = ["python3", "solace-cli/tests/reference_layout.py", "{file}"]` under `[validators]` in the root `solace.toml`. Agents can't edit that file, so ask with `task ask` and give the exact line. After that, a `write` that misaligns the reference is refused at once and names the line and column.
- **Run it now** against the current file. Fix whatever it finds, so the file starts clean.
- **Records:** a decision in `DECISIONS.md`, and one line in `solace-cli/README.md` next to the `src/reference.txt` entry.

## Tests
A unit test in `main.rs` runs the script on `REFERENCE` as embedded and expects exit 0, so `rust-unit` also catches a reference that was changed some other way. Script cases, on small sample texts: a continuation line one column too far right fails and names its line; one column too far left fails; a consistent indented example block passes; an example block with mixed columns fails; a line over the width fails.
title: reference: layout validator
